我们的研究人员一定能够从这样的情报中发掘到可用之物。

texts.zh:
勘测过[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]的冰冻地面后，我们获得了重大发现。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说，发现了一种独一无二的细菌生物。它会跟其他个体连接起来组成巨大的“毯子”，这种毯子既轻便耐用，又能用作太阳能电池。它们能够非常高效地转化吸收到的太阳能——似乎是为了在这种环境下尽可能吸收多的热能而进化出来的。

我们的研究人员一定能够从这样的情报中发掘到可用之物。
texts.en:
Having probed the frozen landscapes of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] we think we have struck something big. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speaks of a bacterial lifeform unlike any other. It bonds with other individuals to form large "blankets" that are durable yet light, and also act like solar cells. They absorb solar energy with surprising efficiency - most likely a result of evolution favoring those who could gather more heat in the harsh climate.

Our researchers back home could surely find some use for this information.

label.zh: 分析它是否能够改善能量生产。
label.en: Find out if it can improve energy production.
Try and find a military use.

texts.zh: 我们的能源开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们利用该生物为模板，成功开发了一种新的太阳能电池。这种电池能够更高效地储存能量并提高我们所有发电站的效率。
texts.en: Our energy development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have been able to develop a new type of solar cell using the organisms as a template. These are much more efficient at storing energy and will provide a boost to all our power plants.

texts.zh: 我们的军事开发研究员从我们发过去的[From.From.GetName]样本中取得了进展！他们改造了生物太阳能电池并分析了它们是如何储存热能而让自身不受伤害。这将有助于开发一种全新的舰队防御技术。
texts.en: Our military development researchers have made progress with the samples we sent them from [From.From.GetName]! They have reconstructed the biological solar cells and documented how they retain heat energy within themselves without taking damage. This has helped them develop a new defensive technology for our fleets.
